A LITTLE MORE CLARITY

Good questions.
Straight answers.

Still thinking through the possibilities?
Talk to our team.

What is an AI employee?

An AI employee is a digital worker configured for a business role. It uses specialised agents, your knowledge and approved tools to complete defined workflows, such as qualifying an enquiry, updating a CRM and arranging the next step.

How is this different from a chatbot?

A chatbot primarily answers questions. An AI employee can also use tools and take actions within agreed rules. An agentic system coordinates several agents to carry a task through multiple stages, with checks and human handoffs.

Where should we start?

Start with one repeatable process that takes time, has clear inputs and produces an outcome you can measure. During discovery we map the steps, identify exceptions and decide what should remain with your team.

Can it work with our existing software?

We assess your calendar, CRM, accounting and specialist systems during discovery. The available APIs, access permissions and vendor restrictions determine the integration. We confirm the supported actions before building.

What happens when it needs a human?

We define when the system must pause, ask for clarification or hand a task to your team. Sensitive decisions and actions can require approval. The handoff should include the context and work already completed.

How long does it take, and what does it cost?

Timing and pricing depend on the roles, integrations and complexity of the workflow. We scope these with you first, including setup, running costs, testing and ongoing support. Start with a discovery conversation for a specific proposal.

Can an AI employee communicate by voice?

Yes, voice can be one interface, alongside email, chat and forms. The role and workflow determine how your AI employee communicates. The work it completes is the focus.
